acceptance: morize-core exports MutationTerminalState with current baseline variants Committed, Rejected, Failed, and UnknownOutcome and no additional current variant.
MutationTerminalState is marked non_exhaustive because docs/DATA_MODEL.md calls these planned terminal semantics rather than declaring a permanently closed public vocabulary.
All four current variants are fieldless, and UnknownOutcome is documented as non-success without implementing reconciliation or dependent-mutation blocking behavior.

MutationTerminalState supports Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, and Hash; focused tests exercise all four current variants and confirm distinct value semantics without defining an ordering contract.

The implementation defines no mutation record, transition engine, transition legality, retry/idempotency policy, compare-and-swap, reconciliation algorithm, dependent-mutation blocking execution, Display, FromStr, parser, serde integration, numeric repr/discriminants, or wire/persistence format.
cargo fmt --all -- --check passes on the exact implementation head.
cargo check --workspace --all-targets --offline passes on the exact implementation head.
cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --offline -- -D warnings passes on the exact implementation head.
cargo test --workspace --all-targets --offline passes and includes focused tests for all four current mutation terminal states and required value semantics.
Cargo manifests and Cargo.lock are unchanged; the Grain admits no runtime, build, or test dependency.
GitHub Actions passes Ubuntu, macOS, and Windows on the exact implementation head before acceptance.

An independent semantic reviewer reviews the exact implementation head for four-state baseline fidelity, non-exhaustive compatibility choice, UnknownOutcome non-success semantics, absence of transition/reconciliation/persistence behavior, scope containment, and required evidence.
ADR-0004 proof prerequisite for SG-000011 revalidates against the exact WorkPacket baseline before execution.
The implementation changes no path outside crates/morize-core/src/mutation.rs and crates/morize-core/src/lib.rs.

method.control: Implementation is limited to one dependency-free non-exhaustive in-memory MutationTerminalState enum, focused tests, and morize-core re-exports. No mutation record, transition engine, dependent-mutation blocking, reconciliation execution, retry/idempotency policy, persistence, serialization, transport mapping, or third-party dependency is authorized.
method.review_separation: An independent semantic reviewer must review the exact implementation head, exact four-state baseline fidelity, non-exhaustive compatibility choice, UNKNOWN_OUTCOME non-success semantics, absence of transition/reconciliation/persistence behavior, scope containment, and required evidence separately from the implementing agent before acceptance.
method.rollback: Revert the mutation-terminal-state implementation commits; no persisted mutation record, transition engine, retry state, reconciliation state, transport contract, or user data depends on this Grain.

minimality.rationale: One standard-library-only four-variant baseline enum is the narrowest implementation of the already-documented mutation terminal-state vocabulary while deferring mutation records, transition/reconciliation behavior, retry/idempotency policy, serialization, and persistence.

requirements: UnknownOutcome must remain a non-success classification; this primitive must not silently convert ambiguous completion into success or itself authorize dependent mutations.

outcome: morize-core exposes one dependency-free non-exhaustive MutationTerminalState enum covering the four planned terminal states already fixed by docs/DATA_MODEL.md, without defining mutation records, transition rules, dependent-mutation blocking, reconciliation execution, retry/idempotency policy, serialization, persistence, or transport semantics.
rationale: docs/DATA_MODEL.md fixes the planned mutation terminal states as COMMITTED, REJECTED, FAILED, and UNKNOWN_OUTCOME and states that unknown outcome is not success. This Grain adds only the typed terminal-state distinction so later mutation/reconciliation Grains can build on a bounded vocabulary without inventing transition, retry, persistence, or orchestration behavior.

risk.recovery: Revert the mutation-terminal-state implementation commits; no persisted mutation record, transition engine, retry state, reconciliation state, transport contract, or user data has been written by this Grain.

scope_in: Define public non-exhaustive MutationTerminalState with current baseline variants Committed, Rejected, Failed, and UnknownOutcome, matching docs/DATA_MODEL.md planned terminal semantics.

Keep all four current variants fieldless and derive only Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, and Hash so terminal state is typed without defining ordering, textual/numeric encoding, transition legality, retryability, or transport behavior.
Document UnknownOutcome as an ambiguous non-success terminal classification. The enum itself does not perform reconciliation or authorize/execute dependent mutations.

Add standard-library-only focused tests covering all four current values, distinct equality/hash semantics, Copy behavior, and the exact current baseline variant set without serialization or parser contracts.
scope_out: Mutation record structs, mutation IDs, action payloads, state-transition machines, transition legality, terminal-state constructors, durable write boundaries, commit protocols, or side effects.
Dependent-mutation blocking enforcement, reconciliation algorithms, retry/idempotency policy, compare-and-swap, crash recovery, cancellation, or unknown-outcome resolution.

Display/FromStr, parsers, serde or other serialization integration, numeric repr/discriminants, persisted or wire encoding, HTTP/IPC/MCP mappings, CLI exit codes, configuration, migrations, storage, or retrieval integration.
Any third-party runtime, build, or test dependency.
